evidence: demo/showcase/oscar-acwm-accepted-comparison.mp4 is an 81-frame 1280x480 H.264 comparison of native lift-arc carry-right and native lift-up.
demo/showcase/oscar-acwm-carry-right.mp4 is the exact reviewed model output with SHA-256 and scores recorded in demo/showcase/oscar-acwm-evaluation.json.
The manifest marks the structure-lock attempt USER_REJECTED_RIGID_TRANSLATION and lists only native lift-up and native carry-right as accepted cases.
The local server returns the new video, the JavaScript parses, all three relevant media assets decode as 81 frames at 15 FPS, and 22 focused CPU tests pass.
lessons: The primary comparison should show two native articulated generations; rejected rigid repairs belong in a clearly labelled historical evidence view.
limitations: The browser demo loads retained evidence and does not execute OSCAR interactively on the client.
scope: Portable AC-WM showcase updated from rigid structure lock to native articulated carry-right
summary: The demo now uses the reviewed native OSCAR lift-arc carry-right video on the left, keeps the native lift on the right, and demotes both direct-slide attempts to rejected history.
